summary: Sanitized repository copies of the three Stage-1 PowerShell transcripts of the live WSL distributions, written by Start-Transcript as adoption/platforms/linux-wsl2-new-distro.md:68 directs. Before this harvest they existed only on Z:, and they are the first-hand install logs for NativeStack2604 (2026-10-02) and NativeHorizonNY (2026-10-15). The third is NativeHorizonNY-r1, a distribution installed and unregistered just before NativeHorizonNY.
source_step: H01 of the command center's Z: cleanup plan, ~/horizon-build/command-center/cleanup/Z-CLEANUP-PLAN-20261017.md on NativeHorizonNY (outside this repository). Its run receipt ~/horizon-build/command-center/cleanup/RUN-20261017.log holds 'H01 gate gwin: PASS (rc=0)' and 'H01 start' at 2026-10-17T02:15:07Z, followed by the sha256sum line of each original.
raw_retention: The unredacted transcripts are private raw logs (adoption/platforms/linux-wsl2-new-distro.md:1247, docs/evidence.md:20). They stay on Z: at original.path, unchanged, and are not committed. Only the sanitized copies listed here are published.
sanitize_rule: adoption/platforms/linux-wsl2-new-distro.md:1248-1250: the Windows user name becomes <win-user>, the profile path %USERPROFILE%, the Linux user name <WSL_USER>, its home ~, and the checkout path <checkout>; any GUID is dropped.
In \\wsl.localhost UNC paths, only the Linux user name segment after \home\ is replaced (with <WSL_USER>), so the distribution name and the rest of the path stay readable.
transformations: Every redaction replaces text inside a line. No line is added or removed, so a line number in a copy is the same line in its original.
CRLF line endings become LF, because .gitattributes:2 sets '* text=auto eol=lf'. A CRLF working file would hash differently from a clean checkout of the committed blob.
NativeStack2604-stage1.log keeps its UTF-8 byte-order mark. The two NativeHorizonNY transcripts are ASCII.

review.method: The private values come from the repository's own scanner sources (scripts/host_name_scan.py host_names() on the recording host) and from the transcript headers. Nothing was typed by hand. After replacement, a case-insensitive search finds none of the 7 source values in any copy, and no scripts/validate.py PRIVATE_CONTENT pattern, email address, GUID, key or token marker matches.

scanner.copies: python3 scripts/validate.py --scan-file on the three copies, on the recording host: status passed, matching_locations 0, source host.
scanner.positive_control: The same scan on the unredacted private working copies: status failed, matching_locations 66. That equals the 66 distinct redacted lines listed under files[].redactions.

not_found: email addresses (the only '@' token is the systemd unit instance getty@tty1.service)
kept: distribution names (NativeStack, NativeStack2604, NativeHorizonNY, NativeHorizonNY-r1), which are public distro identifiers (docs/decisions/2026-10-09-host-name-scan.md:9-10)
PowerShell and Windows build version strings, process IDs, and Z: used and free byte counts

the image sha256 (adoption/new-wsl-profile.json:34) and the two cloud-init user-data render sha256 values (the stage-1 receipt keeps a render hash, adoption/templates/wsl/stage1-receipt.example.json:56; the NativeStack2604 value is already published in evidence/artifacts/new-wsl-rehearsal-20261002/runs-on-wsl-3.0.1.json)

limitations: These are sanitized transcripts, not a stage-1 receipt. They add no receipts[] row and claim nothing beyond what each transcript printed. A stage-1 receipt for either live distribution (adoption/platforms/linux-wsl2-new-distro.md, 'Stage-1 receipt') can be cut from them later.

Most output of the native commands run through wsl.exe is missing. The NativeStack2604 transcript shows a blank line before each [exit=N] marker, and the NativeHorizonNY transcripts show blank lines under each '== <check>' heading. These copies therefore record the commands and their exit codes, not that output.
Transcript times carry no zone. Each file's last End time equals its original's mtime at UTC-4 (EDT), so they are Windows local time.
